title: Chemical and microbial quality of bottled drinking water in Gonabad city, Iran: Effect of time and storage conditions on microbial quality of bottled waters
author: Shams, Qasemi, et al.

steps.title: Collect bottled water samples
steps.instruction: Randomly select nine non‑carbonated bottled water brands sold in Gonabad markets and obtain one 500 mL bottle of each brand for analysis.

steps.title: Store samples under defined conditions
steps.instruction: Place the bottles into four storage groups: (1) refrigeration at 4 °C, (2) direct sunlight at 25 °C, (3) indirect sunlight at 20 °C, and (4) darkness at 20 °C. Keep the bottles under these conditions for a total of two months.

steps.title: Perform weekly sampling
steps.instruction: Once per week for eight weeks, withdraw an aliquot from each bottle for chemical and microbial testing.

steps.title: Measure pH of each sample
steps.instruction: Use a pH meter model WTW 340i to record the pH of each aliquot.

steps.title: Determine chemical parameters
steps.instruction: Analyze each aliquot for the following constituents using the indicated methods:

substeps.instruction: Sodium (Na) and potassium (K) – flame photometer (Jenway Co.).
Sulfate – turbidity measurement with a UNICO turbidimeter.

steps.title: Enumerate heterotrophic bacteria
steps.instruction: Plate appropriate dilutions on R2A agar, incubate at 35 °C for 48 h, count colonies with a colony counter and express results as cfu mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Enumerate pathogenic bacteria
steps.instruction: Plate appropriate dilutions on blood agar, incubate at 35 °C for 48 h, count colonies with a colony counter and express results as cfu mL⁻¹.

steps.title: Test for coliforms and fecal streptococcus

substeps.instruction: Inoculate McConkey's Lactose Bile Salt Broth with Bromocresol purple and Brilliant Green Lactose Bile Broth (BGLB); incubate at 35 °C for 48 h for coliform detection.
Conduct fecal streptococcus analysis according to Standard Methods 9230; dark colony formation on the specified medium indicates presence.

steps.title: Determine most probable number of fecal coliforms
steps.instruction: Carry out an MPN assay by incubating inoculated tubes at 35 °C for 3–5 days; calculate and report results as MPN per 100 mL.

steps.title: Assess Clostridium perfringens
steps.instruction: Inoculate milk agar with the sample and follow the standard method for C. perfringens; record presence or absence after incubation.
